math.label: sqrt(number)
math.detail: Returns the square root of a float/number

math.label: cbrt(number)
math.detail: Returns the cubic root of a float/number

math.label: root(base, exp)
math.detail: Returns the exponent root of the base

math.label: log(base, exp)
math.detail: Returns the logarithm of the base to the result

math.label: loge(number)
math.detail: Returns the natural logarithm of the number

math.label: log10(number)
math.detail: Returns the base-10 logarithm of the number

math.label: reciprocal(number)
math.detail: Gives 1 divided by the number

math.label: cos(angle)
math.detail: Gives the cosine value of an angle

math.label: sin(angle)
math.detail: Gives the sine value of an angle

math.label: tan(angle)
math.detail: Gives the tangent value of an angle

math.label: sec(angle)
math.detail: Gives for an angle 1 / cosine(angle)

math.label: cosec(angle)
math.detail: Gives for an angle 1 / sine(angle)

math.label: cotan(angle)
math.detail: Gives for an angle 1 / tan(angle)

math.label: iCos(number)
math.detail: Gives the inverse cosine value of a number between -1 and 1

math.label: iSin(number)
math.detail: Gives the inverse sin value of a number between -1 and 1

math.label: iTan(number)
math.detail: Gives the inverse tan value of a number

math.label: iSec(number)
math.detail: Gives the inverse sec value of a number out of the range between -1 and 1

math.label: iCosec(number)
math.detail: Gives the inverse cosec value of a number out of the range between -1 and 1

math.label: iCotan(number)
math.detail: Gives the inverse cotan value of a number

math.label: cosh(angle)
math.detail: Gives the hyperbolic cos value of an angle

math.label: sinh(angle)
math.detail: Gives the hyperbolic sin value of an angle

math.label: tanh(angle)
math.detail: Gives the hyperbolic tan value of an angle

math.label: iCosh(number)
math.detail: Gives the inverse cosh value of a number above or equal to 1

math.label: iSinh(number)
math.detail: Gives the inverse sinh value of a number

math.label: iTanh(number)
math.detail: Gives the inverse tanh value of a number between -1 and 1

math.label: abs(number)
math.detail: Returns the absolute value

math.label: round(number)
math.detail: Returns the closest integer to the number given. When given half (X.5), this rounds away from X

math.label: floor(number)
math.detail: Returns the smallest integer less than or equal to the number

math.label: ceil(number)
math.detail: Returns the smallest integer more than or equal to the number

math.label: PI
math.detail: Constant value of pi

math.label: eul
math.detail: Constant value of Euler's number

math.label: rt1
math.detail: Constant value of sqrt of 2

math.label: phi
math.detail: Constant value of phi, the golden ratio

math.label: c
math.detail: Constant value of the speed of light

iterables.label: countChars(str)
iterables.detail: Returns a dictionary of characters and the number of appearances in the string

iterables.label: countExistingChars(str)
iterables.detail: Returns a dictionary of characters that appeared in the string and the number of appearances in the string

iterables.label: toDictionary(keysList, valuesList)
iterables.detail: Intakes a keys list, and a values list, and creates a dictionary out of the two

iterables.label: alphabet
iterables.detail: A list of the lowercase alphabet. In order of a-z
